chunks: As for what ʿAlī ibn Mahziyār narrated, he said:
I saw Abā Jaʿfar al-Thānī عليه السلام spit in al-Masjid al-Ḥarām between al-Rukn al-Yamānī and al-Ḥajar al-Aswad, and he did not bury it.

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ الثَّانِيَ: Abā Jaʿfar al-Thānī, the second of the Imams known by this kunyah
key_terms.الرُّكْنِ الْيَمَانِيِّ: the Yemeni Corner of the Kaʿbah
key_terms.وَلَمْ يَدْفِنْهُ: and he did not cover or bury it

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith indicate about spitting in al-Masjid al-Ḥarām?
ai.summary: This report narrates that Abā Jaʿfar al-Thānī عليه السلام was seen spitting in al-Masjid al-Ḥarām between al-Rukn al-Yamānī and al-Ḥajar al-Aswad without covering it. In the context of the chapter, it relates to the legal discussion on the reprehensibility of spitting in the masjid and exceptions or contextual qualifications derived from transmitted reports.
